FN SMP

Build, explore and play Minecraft with the squad. Apply for the whitelist in Discord to get started.

Open Discord to applyHow to join

How to join

  1. Join Discord

    Open the FN Squad server and read #rules. Check the age requirements for your country.

  2. Apply for the whitelist

    Find #whitelist-apply and answer the questions there.

  3. Wait for approval

    The team will follow up in Discord. Use the connection details they confirm.

Server details

Ask the team for the confirmed address, edition and version after your whitelist application is approved.

FN SMP WhatsApp group

Other group members can see your phone number.

Server rules

Fair play

No hacked clients, x-ray, autoclickers, exploits or lag machines. Report bugs to staff. Check which client mods are allowed before using them.

Claims, builds and PvP

No griefing, theft, trapping or spawn-killing. Build at least 100 blocks from existing bases unless the owner agrees. PvP requires mutual consent or a designated arena.

Accounts, chat and inactive claims

Use one main account and declare alternate accounts. Keep signs, builds and chat respectful. Claims may be released after 90 days of inactivity with a Discord warning. Ask staff about holding a claim if you are taking a break.

Reports and appeals

Send evidence to staff privately. You can appeal a ban within 14 days using the Discord appeal process. See the community moderation policy.

FN SMP FAQ

Do I need mods?

Confirm the server mode and any required modpack with the team in Discord.

Is FN SMP pay-to-win?

Playing does not require a donation. FN SMP does not sell in-game items, claims or rule exceptions.

How do I find the server address?

Ask the team through Discord once they approve your whitelist application. See server details.
